messages:
maria: Quick check — planning to push quant-v3 (4-bit NF4) behind a 3% AB slice tomorrow. Need final gating thresholds for quality and perf. cc @akshay @danielle

akshay: Sounds reasonable. Baseline is v2p1 fp16, right? What's the eval corpus for the canary? Any sensitive slices we should weight?

danielle: Using the standard 5k convo holdout + 2k structured returns. We'll report MRR, hallucination rate, and BLEU-like exact match for structured. Propose gates: MRR drop <= 1.5% and hallucination delta <= 0.5%.

samir: Also need infra guards — if p99 latency increases >15% or p95 >10% relative to baseline -> auto-fallback. Past rollouts hit tail spikes.

maria: Can we add per-slice fail-fast? If any labeled slice sees >3% absolute MRR drop -> remove that slice from variant and alert + rollback that fraction. We hit slice regressions last quarter.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: 3788881234 -> canary 3% -> start 08:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks: model.mrr.mean, model.halluc.rate, infra.latency.p99, infra.tokens/sec. Shadow compare enabled at 10% sample.

akshay: How are we computing "hallucination" this run? same heuristic as before (quote mismatch + entity halluc filter)?

danielle: Yes, same pipeline but we added a secondary LLM-checker pass to reduce false positives on short-turns. We'll publish the detection precision/recall in the report.

maria: Add a cumulative check: if cumulative MRR drop over 24h >= 2% -> trigger full rollback.

samir: Important: use bootstrapped 95% CI for deltas and require the delta to be outside CI to avoid spurious rollbacks from noise.

akshay: Also add a throughput guard: if tokens/sec on the dedicated pool drops >20% -> pause rollout and route traffic back to baseline.

danielle: I'll prepare an ops checklist and add the alert thresholds in the Redwood Console. Alerts to: #eng-oncall and pager if SLA break detected.

maria: :thumbsup: Timeline — ops doc by EOD, staging smoke run at 03:00 UTC, canary at 08:00 UTC.

samir: Note for runbook: metric names and tags are model:m:v3-quant, slice:<name>, cohort:canary. Key metrics: model.mrr.mean, model.halluc.rate, infra.latency.p99, infra.tokens/sec.

maria: Thanks team. If anyone wants to nudge thresholds (esp. hallucination sensitivity) speak now; otherwise we'll follow this gating plan and iterate after the smoke.
